description: This file defines a Java class 'ForeClosureCommandHandler' which handles foreclosure commands for loans within the Fineract platform. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and delegates the foreclosure operation to the 'LoanWritePlatformService'.

classes.name: ForeClosureCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles foreclosure commands for loans, identified by the @CommandType annotation with entity 'LOAN' and action 'FORECLOSURE'. It delegates the foreclosure process to the underlying loan write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a foreclosure command by calling the 'forecloseLoan' method on the 'LoanWritePlatformService' with the loan ID and command details.
